name: Bloom Oil
short: Twelve botanicals steeped in cold-pressed almond oil for six weeks.
description: Twelve botanicals steeped in cold-pressed sweet almond oil for six weeks, no heat, then pressed and filtered twice. Three drops at night, warmed between the palms. It sinks in rather than sitting on top.

name: Ubtan No.1
short: Chickpea, sandalwood, turmeric and oat, milled fine.
description: Chickpea flour, sandalwood, turmeric and oat, milled fine. Mix a spoonful with milk or water into a paste. Takes the place of face wash on days your skin wants something gentler than foam.

name: Clay Mask
short: Multani mitti with neem and powdered rose.
description: Multani mitti with neem and powdered rose. Twice a week, ten minutes, rinse before it cracks. Draws out the week without stripping everything else with it.

name: Whipped Body Butter
short: Mango butter and kokum whipped for twenty minutes.
description: Mango butter and kokum whipped for twenty minutes until it holds a peak, scented only with jasmine absolute. Goes on best straight out of the shower, on skin that is still slightly damp.

name: Hair Oil No.3
short: Bhringraj, amla and curry leaf in cold-pressed coconut.
description: Bhringraj, amla and curry leaf simmered slowly into cold-pressed coconut oil, then rested a fortnight. Warm it, work it into the scalp, leave it an hour. Smells like a grandmother's kitchen, in the good way.

name: Kokum Lip Balm
short: Kokum butter, beeswax and a little beetroot.
description: Kokum butter, beeswax and a little beetroot for the faintest wash of colour. Vanilla, no flavouring. Firm in winter, soft in a Jaipur summer — that is the butter behaving normally.
